firstFive.what: A personal site for one person: a terminal-styled portfolio, black with a green neon accent, headed by a name, a role line and a Möbius clip that opens its own man page.
firstFive.who: Someone deciding whether to work with Karim. They arrived from a conversation or a link and want to know what he has actually shipped.
firstFive.action: Reach him. Seven contact tiles sit under the tagline, above the fold, before any scrolling.

goal.outcome: The page he already signed off on, with more ways to reach him than it had.
goal.path: Land, read the name and the tagline, click a contact tile, or click the Möbius to decode it. Scroll for the about copy, the face and the projects.
goal.why: shot-1440 is the layout he approved: the Möbius is the hero's right column at full height and the face sits beside the about copy where it was. Nothing from the size experiment survives in the render. The only difference from that approved page is the contact row, which is one tile longer and still one row. This iteration only changes the address in the email tile and the resume chip, so the approved layout is untouched; the resume chip is wider and the print sheet still fits one page.

states.reduced-motion: The size transitions that needed a motion-reduce guard are gone with the revert. What remains is the pre-existing behaviour: the intro cover resolves to opacity 0, the socials drop their hover lift and the Möbius manual drops its slide, all already handled by useReducedMotion in the components. The faster timings do not reach this path: reduced motion still resolves to mode 'static' and never mounts the video.
states.manual-open: Captured with --state clicking the visible decode button. The frame does not resize any more, so the man page renders at its natural size in a 473x612 box, the same as before this session.
